description: This PHP class defines a plugin for geographic delivery limitations based on country and subdivision levels, including methods for initialization, display, data flattening/expanding, and subdivision retrieval.

classes.name: Plugins_DeliveryLimitations_Geo_Subdivision1
classes.description: A plugin class for geographic delivery limitations based on country and subdivision levels, extending a comma-separated data plugin and using a geographic trait.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the plugin and sets its English name.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin data, flattening it if it's an array.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if the plugin is permitted in the current context based on capability.

methods.name: displayArrayData
methods.description: Outputs HTML for selecting country and subdivisions.

methods.name: _flattenData
methods.description: Converts nested data into a flattened string format for storage.

methods.name: _expandData
methods.description: Expands stored string data into an array with country and subdivision codes.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Prepares data for storage by compiling it.

methods.name: _preCompile
methods.description: Prepares data for compilation by expanding and flattening.

methods.name: getSubdivisions
methods.description: Retrieves subdivisions for a given country code.
